2120	he trusts him. There are children like that. Maran told us

2121	that in his childhood he was a public benefactor, he would write Birkat

2122	HaMazon in his own handwriting, go during the lunch breaks and give it

2123	to this friend and that friend. You see, already in childhood,

2124	as he grows up, you see a high soul, he cares for the public,

2125	makes Birkat HaMazon for them, does things. He would learn

2126	pure Torah, was expert in this book, he sat and turned over

2127	the Midrashim, not lower than what is in the Midrashim, showing

2128	the words of Chazal. There are little children with

2129	a high soul. So a person trusts

2130	him, the little child never lies, so he

2131	can be relied upon even in matters

2132	of Torah law. There is also such a thing regarding the quality of

2133	lashon hara. The quality of lashon hara. First of all, in shidduchim

2134	there is no lashon hara. They ask the mashgiach whether this young man

2135	is good or not good. There is no need to say all

2136	the details. In general. This young man will surely, after

2137	the wedding, improve himself more. He will be diligent.

2138	One can leave some out. He need not say all the

2139	details. All the more so if he truly is diligent. If

2140	he knows that he takes pills, he must say it

2141	in shidduchim. It is forbidden to be silent, lest through his sin

2142	this man be caught and this sin be on him, that he marry

2143	a daughter of Israel, if the young man took pills, or the reverse,

2144	if she takes pills, one must say such a thing. This is

2145	lashon hara. Do not be overly righteous, one must say it,

2146	one should ask a rav. If a person does not know how to say it in a shidduch,

2147	how to say the shortcomings, consult with a rav. The rav knows when

2148	to say and when not to say. There are obvious shortcomings, and there are

2149	things said before the wedding that pass afterwards,

2150	they change. We, in the yeshiva, there were good young men,

2151	diligent, with immense diligence. There were some who were not

2152	all equal, not all with the same drive, and I always

2153	speak well of them. Afterwards I see them after

2154	the wedding rising and ascending. A good young woman,

2155	a righteous one who loves Torah, gives him nice encouragement, praises

2156	him, constantly supports him in his Torah,

2157	he changes completely. So why say that he is not diligent? Why say such a thing? Not always

2158	should you say it.

2159	If he is... one must weigh the matter.
